trust_decision.summary: Topic `name` from a mirror's remote topics.json manifest is trusted verbatim and spliced into the generated APT sources file (comment header and Suites/branch field); the fix rejects names containing control characters at manifest load (refresh_innter filter) and at enable (TopicManager::add).

landing_point.why: Advisory names oma-topic and the topic.json name field; TopicManager::add (enable topic) and the refresh/manifest parse in the same file are the obvious first stops.

fix_sites.entry_point: TopicManager::refresh (public API) via `oma topics`/`oma atm`, `oma refresh` (oma-refresh/src/db.rs:442), `oma mirror` (src/subcommand/mirror.rs:784), `oma history undo` (src/subcommand/history.rs:265)
TopicManager::add (public API) via `oma topics --opt-in` (src/subcommand/topics.rs:419) and `oma history undo` (src/subcommand/history.rs:274)
CLI error rendering for OmaTopicsError (escape_default on name)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All substantive fix lines are in oma-topics/src/lib.rs; src/error.rs:570 is only error display.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ATM state file (/var/lib/atm/state) is root-owned local state written by oma itself, so names reloaded from it look trusted and the revert/comment-header path that writes them seems not to need a check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate topic names (ASCII, hyphens, dots, possibly non-ASCII description) must still be enabled, written to sources and matched case-insensitively; an over-broad filter (e.g. rejecting the whole manifest via try/? on one bad entry, or stripping non-ASCII) breaks refresh for every other topic on that mirror and the close-topic flow in oma refresh.

O6_input_shapes: name containing CR/LF (any Unicode control char via char::is_control) in remote manifest
same name reached via user-typed opt-in matched case-insensitively against the manifest

O7_producer.where: oma-topics/src/lib.rs:275-282 (write_enabled serializes enabled topics to state) and oma-topics/src/lib.rs:138 (state deserialized in TopicManager::new without validation)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Topic names reloaded from the ATM state file are written into the `# Topic` comment line before the mirror-membership check, so a name persisted before the fix still injects lines
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: state file is root-owned and written by oma itself, not remote input
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix (lib.rs:138 load -> lib.rs:338 sink), but different phase (constructor/deserialization vs refresh/add)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Revert path writes old_enabled (straight from the state file) via write_sources_list(revert=true); header line emitted unconditionally
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: error-recovery/rollback path that restores a previously accepted configuration

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Topic name passed to message_cb and printed with warn!/fl! unescaped (log/terminal line injection) for topics not on a mirror
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: terminal output, not the sources file the advisory names; neighbouring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; callers in src/subcommand/topics.rs:180-186, src/subcommand/mirror.rs:789-795, src/subcommand/history.rs:283-289, oma-refresh/src/db.rs:466-468

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second manifest field (e.g. description or a per-topic suite/component override) copied into the sources file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Topic already deserializes several manifest fields; adding a suite or component override routed into write_sources_inner is a plausible feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mirror URL from custom mirror config written via write_sources_inner without line-break check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same writer, URL comes from config merged at oma-mirror/src/lib.rs:129; a custom-mirror add command taking a URL would be natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: suite derived from URL path segment matched against topic names and fed back to sources
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the name<->suite round trip already exists for closing topics.

O9_family: CRLF / line injection into generated APT sources configuration (CWE-93)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo, Rust stable supporting edition 2024; workspace with oma-topics, oma-mirror, oma-refresh crates; libapt-pkg needed for the main binary (oma-apt)
O10_build.project_tests: No #[test] in oma-topics or oma-mirror; oma-topics/examples/menu.rs only. get() accepts file:// manifest URLs (oma-topics/src/lib.rs:418-425), so tests can run offline against a sysroot with template.toml.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject control characters in TopicManager::add only (or only at refresh), leaving state-file reload and the revert/comment-header write open.

out_of_scope_notes: Topic description shown unescaped in the TUI (src/subcommand/topics.rs:111-113): terminal-escape display issue, different sink.
is_control does not cover spaces; a space in a name would add extra suites/components in the one-line format (oma-mirror/src/lib.rs:299-302); not CRLF.
